items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 15 at 2:20PM PST until November 17 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 20 to 25 ft, with occasional
sets of 25 to 35 ft at favored breakpoints.

* WHERE...San Francisco, Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes
National Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern
Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast
Counties.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 16 at 2:31AM PST until November 17 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, seas 9 to 14 ft. For the
Gale Watch, south winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt
possible.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Point Reyes to Pigeon Point
California out to 10 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 9 AM PST Tuesday.
For the Gale Watch, from Tuesday evening through late Tuesday
night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
